description:
Tick is a fast, local-first market watchlist for your pocket: see how the symbols you care about are doing without opening a trading terminal.

WATCHLISTS
US stocks, Hong Kong stocks, China A-shares, Japanese and Korean stocks, cryptocurrencies, precious metals, indices, and ETFs. Organize symbols into named groups, switch between them with one tap, and remove what you no longer follow.

DETAILS & CHARTS
Intraday lines and daily / weekly / monthly candlesticks with volume, plus price, change, OHLC, amplitude, realtime / delayed status, and source attribution. Drag the chart to look back, and tap a period to switch resolutions.

MULTI-PROVIDER ROUTING
Each market routes to the best available data source (Eastmoney, Tencent, Sina, Yahoo, Naver, Binance and more) with automatic caching and failover. Providers poll only while their markets are open, each at its own cadence.

REAL-TIME CRYPTO
Binance Spot public market data: symbol search, quotes, and charts, with 1-second WebSocket ticker updates while the app is open.

PRECIOUS METALS
London spot gold and silver, COMEX / NYMEX contracts, SGE Au99.99, and SHFE gold and silver futures. Searching "gold" lists all three golds.

LONGBRIDGE REAL-TIME (OPTIONAL)
Connect your own Longbridge account with browser authorization to upgrade HK / US / A-share quotes to official real-time data, including the US overnight session. Credentials stay in your Keychain.

PRIVACY
No personal data collection, no built-in analytics. Watchlists and credentials stay on your device. See the privacy policy for details.

Tick is built on the open-source Pulse project (MIT license).
promotionalText: Your watchlist, charts and quotes — without the terminal.
whatsNew: First App Store release: watchlists, intraday and candlestick charts, real-time crypto, precious metals, and optional Longbridge real-time data.
